Container.Name: openclaw
Container.Overview: The AI that actually does things. OpenClaw is an AI gateway platform that manages agents, channels, and tool execution through an intuitive Control UI.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port for accessing the OpenClaw Control UI

Config.Name: appdata
Config.Description: Stores OpenClaw configuration, agent data, and conversation history

Config.Name: OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_TOKEN
Config.Description: Gateway authentication token (auto-generated if not set)

Config.Name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
Config.Description: Claude API key for AI capabilities (can also be configured via Control UI after installation)
